caption:
Small tool, very clean.

ICQR turns any link into a voxel tree. The ground it grows on is the actual QR code: tap the tree and it folds back into a scannable QR.

→ 3 seasons (spring, summer, autumn)
→ pick the leaf color
→ ambient sound, export in one click

Comment "tree" and I’ll send you the link 🌲
